audience: e-commerce teams with an API-enabled Zenfulfillment warehouse account

useCases.title: Track orders and shipments
useCases.text: Find orders by status or reference and inspect their addresses, product lines and shipment tracking numbers.

useCases.title: Find low-stock SKUs
useCases.text: Read warehouse quantities by SKU and filter for products below a chosen stock threshold.

useCases.title: Check inbound deliveries
useCases.text: List inbound shipments and compare announced and arrived quantities for a selected shipment.

useCases.title: Send an order for fulfillment
useCases.text: Check the order reference and stock, then create or update one order for picking, packing and shipping. Production fulfillment and shipping fees apply.

useCases.title: Mark a processed return done
useCases.text: Review processed returns and mark a selected return done. This records the refunded status in Zenfulfillment; it does not pay a refund.
